70991-the-book-of-the-cheese.title: The Book Of The Cheese
70991-the-book-of-the-cheese.creator: Unknown
70991-the-book-of-the-cheese.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Old London is fast disappearing off the face of the earth. One by one its ancient taverns have gone, or if the names familiar to our ancestors have been retained, the hand of the builder has been laid remorselessly on the structures our forefathers knew, and they have been transformed beyond recognition.

arxiv-1805-00879.title: Unsupervised Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval using Monolingual Data Only Conference: SIGIR; July 2018; Ann Arbor, Michigan, USA x Price: 15.00 CCS: Information systems Multilingual and cross-lingual retrieval CCS: Information systems Retrieval models and ranking
arxiv-1805-00879.creator: Robert Litschko, Goran Glavaš, Simone Paolo Ponzetto, Ivan Vulić
arxiv-1805-00879.description: Abstract . We propose a fully unsupervised framework for ad-hoc cross-lingual information retrieval (CLIR) which requires no bilingual data at all. The framework leverages shared cross-lingual word embedding spaces in which terms, queries, and documents can be represented, irrespective of their actual language.

arxiv-2110-14573.title: Autonomous Exploration Development Environment and the Planning Algorithms Thanks: All authors are with the Robotics Institute at Carnegie Mellon University, Pittsburgh PA. Emails: {ccao1, hongbiaz, fanyang2, yukunx, choset, jeanoh, zhangji}@cmu.edu
arxiv-2110-14573.creator: Chao Cao, Hongbiao Zhu, Fan Yang, Yukun Xia, Howie Choset, Jean Oh, Ji Zhang
arxiv-2110-14573.description: Abstract Autonomous Exploration Development Environment is an open-source repository released to facilitate development of high-level planning algorithms and integration of complete autonomous navigation systems. The repository contains representative simulation environment models, fundamental navigation modules, e.g., local planner, terrain traversability analysis, waypoint following, and visualization tools.

arxiv-2402-11633.title: SOLID: Self-seeding and Multi-intent Self-instructing LLMs for Generating Intent-aware Information-Seeking Dialogs
arxiv-2402-11633.creator: Arian Askari, Roxana Petcu, Chuan Meng, Mohammad Aliannejadi, Amin Abolghasemi, Evangelos Kanoulas, Suzan Verberne
arxiv-2402-11633.description: Abstract Intent prediction in information-seeking dialogs is challenging and requires a substantial amount of data with human-labeled intents for effective model training. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated effectiveness in generating synthetic data, existing methods typically rely on human feedback and are tailored to structured, task-oriented intents.

arxiv-2406-14627.title: Bayesian Optimization Priors for Efficient Variational Quantum Algorithms
arxiv-2406-14627.creator: Farshud Sorourifar, Diana Chamaki, Norm M. Tubman, Joel A. Paulson, David E. Bernal Neira
arxiv-2406-14627.description: Abstract Quantum computers currently rely on a hybrid quantum-classical approach known as Variational Quantum Algorithms (VQAs) to solve problems. Still, there are several challenges with VQAs on the classical computing side: it corresponds to a black-box optimization problem that is generally non-convex, the observations from the quantum hardware are noisy, and the quantum computing time is expensive.

arxiv-2412-09723.title: MAC-Ego3D : M ulti- A gent Gaussian C onsensus for Real-Time Collaborative Ego -Motion and Photorealistic 3D Reconstruction
arxiv-2412-09723.creator: Xiaohao Xu, Feng Xue, Shibo Zhao, Yike Pan, Sebastian Scherer, Xiaonan Huang
arxiv-2412-09723.description: Abstract Real-time multi-agent collaboration for ego-motion estimation and high-fidelity 3D reconstruction is vital for scalable spatial intelligence. However, traditional methods produce sparse, low-detail maps, while recent dense mapping approaches struggle with high latency. To overcome these challenges, we present MAC-Ego3D , a novel framework for real-time collaborative photorealistic 3D reconstruction via Multi-Agent Gaussian Consensus .

arxiv-2508-02726.title: MPCA-based Domain Adaptation for Transfer Learning in Ultrasonic Guided Waves
arxiv-2508-02726.creator: Lucio Pinello, Francesco Cadini, Luca Lomazzi
arxiv-2508-02726.description: Abstract Ultrasonic Guided Waves (UGWs) represent a promising diagnostic tool for Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) in thin-walled structures, and their integration with machine learning (ML) algorithms is increasingly being adopted to enable real-time monitoring capabilities. However, the large-scale deployment of UGW-based ML methods is constrained by data scarcity and limited generalisation across different materials and sensor configurations.

arxiv-2509-12133.title: Discovering the D 0 ∗ ​ ( 2100 ) D_{0}^{\ast}(2100) in B B semileptonic decays Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-2509-12133.creator: M.-L. Du addr1, F.-K. Guo addr2,addr3,addr4, C. Hanhart addr5, F. Herren e1,addr6, B. Kubis addr7, R. van Tonder e2,addr8
arxiv-2509-12133.description: Abstract The mass and width of the lightest scalar open-charm state listed in the Review of Particle Physics, the D 0 ∗ ​ ( 2300 ) D_{0}^{\ast}(2300) , are in puzzling tension with predictions from unitarized chiral perturbation theory (UChPT) and lattice QCD, which favor a lighter state at around 2100 2100 MeV.

arxiv-2601-11845.title: Reevaluating Causal Estimation Methods with Data from a Product Release Thanks: For helpful comments, we are grateful to Guido Imbens, Jann Spiess, Vasilis Syrgkanis, Lihua Lei, Julian Nyarko, Stefan Wager, Ramesh Johari, Jason Weitze, Lea Bottmer, David Ritzwoller, Fabio Vera, and conference and se
arxiv-2601-11845.creator: Justin Young, Muthoni Ngatia, Eleanor W. Dillon
arxiv-2601-11845.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Justin Young, Muthoni Ngatia, Eleanor W. Dillon. Recent developments in causal machine learning methods have made it easier to estimate flexible relationships between confounders, treatments and outcomes, making unconfoundedness assumptions in causal analysis more palatable. How successful are these approaches in recovering ground truth baselines? In this paper we analyze a new data sample including an experimental rollout of a new feature at a large technology company and a simultaneous sample of users who endogenously opted into the feature.

britannica-1911-adelsberg.title: Adelsberg (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-adelsberg.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-adelsberg.description: Article 'Adelsberg' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 1), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. subterranean wonders were known as far back as 1213, but the cavern remained undiscovered in modern times until 1816, and it is only in still more recent times that its vast extent has been fully ascertained and explored. The total length of the passages is now estimated at over 52 m. The connexion with the Ottokar grotto was established in 1890.

pmc-11342349.title: A case report of feline mast cell tumour with intertumoral heterogeneity: Identification of secondary mutations c.998G>C and c.2383G>C in KIT after resistance to toceranib
pmc-11342349.creator: Hiroyuki Tani, Tatsuro Hifumi, Keita Ito, Tomohide Kuramoto, Noriaki Miyoshi, Makoto Fujiki, Tomohiro Nakayama
pmc-11342349.description: A 12‐year‐old male domestic cat with multiple subcutaneous mast cell tumours (MCTs) presented with a 2‐week history of pruritus and raw/bleeding skin from self‐trauma at Kagoshima University Veterinary Teaching Hospital. Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and histopathological analyses revealed intertumoral heterogeneity among tumour locations based on the mutation status of KIT. In addition, the expression pattern of KIT was characterized.

pmc-11433641.title: Enteric Nervous System and Its Relationship with Neurological Diseases
pmc-11433641.creator: María José Luesma, Liberto López-Marco, Marta Monzón, Sonia Santander, Andrew Day
pmc-11433641.description: The enteric nervous system (ENS) is a fundamental component of the gastrointestinal system, composed of a vast network of neurons and glial cells. It operates autonomously but is interconnected with the central nervous system (CNS) through the vagus nerve. This communication, known as the gut–brain axis, influences the bidirectional communication between the brain and the gut.

pmc-12126283.title: A Resource Efficient System for On-Smartwatch Audio Processing
pmc-12126283.creator: Md Sabbir Ahmed, Arafat Rahman, Zhiyuan Wang, Mark Rucker, Laura E. Barnes
pmc-12126283.description: While audio data shows promise in addressing various health challenges, there is a lack of research on on-device audio processing for smartwatches. Privacy concerns make storing raw audio and performing post-hoc analysis undesirable for many users. Additionally, current on-device audio processing systems for smartwatches are limited in their feature extraction capabilities, restricting their potential for understanding user behavior and health.

pmc-12607188.title: An early prediction model for high-quality blastocyst development based on ANA titer and baseline demographic characteristics in the first IVF/ICSI cycle
pmc-12607188.creator: Kai Ding, Yidan Chen, Wei Jiang, Xin Li, Xiufeng Ling, Chun Zhao
pmc-12607188.description: BackgroundHigh-quality blastocysts with good developmental potential are crucial for successful pregnancy, yet the factors influencing their formation remain unclear in clinical practice, and no predictive model is available for early clinical use. Antinuclear antibodies (ANA), which are closely associated with autoimmune diseases but are also commonly found in the infertile patients, may significantly impact embryo quality.

pmc-12654816.title: Skim Milk as a Multifunctional Cryoprotectant for Fish Probiotic Enterococcus spp.: Impact on Viability During Lyophilization and Long-Term Storage
pmc-12654816.creator: Matheus Gomes da Cruz, Ana Maria Souza da Silva, Karen Dayana Prada-Mejia, Hector Henrique Ferreira Koolen, Guilherme Campos Tavares, Gustavo Moraes Ramos Valladão, Wujie Xu
pmc-12654816.description: This study investigated the efficacy of different cryoprotectants (maltodextrin, skim milk, trehalose, sucrose, fructose, and dextrose) in protecting probiotic cultures isolated from the microbiota of arapaima (Arapaima gigas) (Enterococcus faecium CRBP46 and Enterococcus gallinarum CRBP19) during lyophilization, storage (−25 °C, 4 °C, and 25 °C for 120 days), and exposure to simulated gastrointestinal fluids (SGF).

pmc-13136896.title: Multiplexed CRISPR base editing enables pulse-activated irreversible biocontainment of engineered bacteria
pmc-13136896.creator: Sung Won Cho, TaeHyun Kim, Jina Yang, Gibyuck Byun, Sang Woo Seo
pmc-13136896.description: The environmental and therapeutic application of genetically engineered microorganisms necessitates the development of robust, irreversible biocontainment systems. In this study, we present an eEGM (editing-driven essential gene multiplex inactivation) module that utilizes CRISPR-mediated cytidine base editing to induce permanent self-killing via a single transient induction.

pmc-13191976.title: Exploring how older adults perceived the impact of infectious diseases and vaccines on ageing: a cross-sectional study in France
pmc-13191976.creator: Alexandra Addario, Gaëtan Gavazzi, Thomas Célarier, Boris Chapoton, Nathalie Barth, Bienvenu Bongue, Elisabeth Botelho-Nevers
pmc-13191976.description: BackgroundThis cross-sectional study examined perceptions of health and ageing, and their influence on vaccine acceptance among individuals aged 65 and older living at home in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region of France.MethodsAnonymous online questionnaires were distributed to users of CARSAT Rhône-Alpes (N1 = 50,000) and Auvergne (N2 = 9,597).

pmc-13388774.title: Measuring complex constructs in large-scale text with computational social mixed methods
pmc-13388774.creator: Alina Herderich, Jana Lasser, Mirta Galesic, Segun Aroyehun, David Garcia, Joshua Garland
pmc-13388774.description: A growing convergence between social science and machine learning enables, in principle, large-scale analyses of complex social phenomena through text. Yet, approaches leveraging supervised text classification based on human-annotated data for statistical analysis often treat conceptual validity and technical performance as separate challenges, impairing measurement quality.

pmc-13486342.title: Sleep-related eating disorder after dose escalation of sodium oxybate in narcolepsy type 1
pmc-13486342.creator: Ranyah A Al Mazyad, Raghad Alhajaji, Hamza O Dhafar, Ahmed S BaHammam
pmc-13486342.description: Sodium oxybate (SO) is an effective therapy for narcolepsy type 1 (NT1) but has been infrequently linked to complex sleep-related behaviors. We describe a case of NT1 who developed sleep-related eating disorder (SRED) after progressive gradual titration of SO. A 15-year-old female was diagnosed with NT1.

In my perspective, legacy P, in the context of water quality management, is P resulting from past land management practices, especially nutrient applications.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Farm Credit Administration may not establish lending limits for the consolidated bank with respect to any loans or borrowers that are more restrictive than the combined lending limits that were previously established.

uslaw-usc-t26-s4999.title: 26 U.S.C. § 4999 — Golden parachute payments
uslaw-usc-t26-s4999.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t26-s4999.description: United States Code, Title 26 (Internal Revenue Code); Chapter 46 (Golden Parachute Payments). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Imposition of tax There is hereby imposed on any person who receives an excess parachute payment a tax equal to 20 percent of the amount of such payment. (b) Excess parachute payment defined For purposes of this section, the term “excess parachute payment”.
